name: Structure of Convex-Treelike Obstructions
statement: Every pc-minimal obstruction to $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$ is either an antipodally punctured hypercube $Q_n^{--}$ or an ample partial cube. Every such obstruction is prime with respect to Cartesian product.
proof: The ample forbidden-minor theorem forces any nonample minimal obstruction to equal a contained $Q_n^{--}$. A nontrivial product has both factors as proper convex pc-minors; product closure would then put the product in the class.
